trigger: Phase Close Context Update Gate step 8

refresh_rules.rule: All 8 snapshot types must be regenerated on phase close
Existing snapshots are RETIRED (not deleted) before regeneration
BALANCED is the default compression level for phase-close refresh
If regeneration fails for a type, mark it STALE and continue with remaining types
After regeneration, validate all snapshots have freshnessStatus=FRESH
Snapshots older than 2 completed phases are auto-RETIRED
ULTRA_COMPACT snapshots are also regenerated but flagged non-autonomous

stale_snapshot_prevention.detection: freshnessStatus != FRESH OR generated_at < last phase-ledger entry timestamp
stale_snapshot_prevention.action: BLOCK mount. Require refresh before use.
stale_snapshot_prevention.fallback: If snapshot is stale, fallback to attach-packet-v3, then query-v2

lifecycle: Snapshots are ephemeral derivatives. They are regenerated on every phase close. Old snapshots are retired, not used as historical evidence.
